convention: Points are [lat, lon], about 60 m outside each bridge end so they snap to a street or path. East-west bridges have eastbound (west to east) and westbound crossings. North-south bridges (Columbia, Blumenauer) have northbound and southbound. lane.side is the side of the bridge a rider uses for that direction: keep right (rule E-01).
order: Willamette north to south, then Columbia west to east, then other crossings.

categories.mixed_use: Mixed use bridge: cars, bikes, and pedestrians share the bridge, on separate lanes, paths, or sidewalks. May also carry buses, streetcar, or rail.
categories.transit_and_pedestrian: Transit and pedestrian bridge: TriMet (MAX, bus, streetcar), bikes, and pedestrians. No private cars.
categories.pedestrian_only: Pedestrian only bridge: bikes and pedestrians only, no motor vehicles.
categories.car_only: Car only bridge: freeway, closed to bikes and pedestrians. Never offered.
categories.freeway_with_path: Freeway bridge with a separate bike and pedestrian path.
categories.pedestrian_overpass: Pedestrian overpass: a bike and pedestrian bridge over a road, freeway, or railway.
categories.mixed_use_overpass: Mixed use overpass: a road overpass with a bike lane.
categories.rail_only: Rail only bridge: trains only. Never offered.
